snippet.title: Kaido Genkai: An Anime Racing RPG - Play Now!
snippet.description:
Play The Chapter 1 Demo Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4581870/Kaido_Genkai_An_Anime_Racing_RPG_Demo/
Support the project: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kaidogenkai/kaido-genkai-an-anime-racing-rpg

Kaido Genkai is an open-world racing exploration game that blends the excitement of high-speed races with the charm of anime-style graphics. Set in a nostalgic 90's fictional Japanese countryside, Kaido Genkai invites you to explore a vibrant world filled with unique characters and hidden treasures. Learn about your past, challenge rivals, and unlock an array of unique cars, each with unique tuned variations!

The open-world environment is rich with secrets waiting to be discovered. Whether you're competing in high-stakes races or leisurely exploring the countryside, Kaido Genkai promises exploration, racing, and adventure with plenty of throwbacks to PS2 era racing games.

The demo features a vertical slice of the full game - explore South Nibiru, and sample the beginning of your adventure with two cars and plenty of races to get excited for!

Website: https://kaidogenkai.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/UX6RHbZBsZ
Twitter/X: https://x.com/KaidoGenkai
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/kaidogenkai/
Threads: https://www.threads.com/@kaidogenkai
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/kaidogenkai.com

Game by Karoshi Electric Company 
https://kaidogenkai.com/

Car models by Hacao
https://www.instagram.com/hacaosuka_works/

Illustrations by HoleeCrab
https://x.com/holeecrab

Trailer by Hamsuko
https://x.com/hamsuko
